sloka: ज्ञातयश्च हि योधाश्च मित्राणि सुहृदश्च न: ।त्वामेव प्रतिकांक्षन्ते पर्जन्यमिव कर्षका: ॥ २.११२.१२॥
transliteration: jñātayaśca hi yodhāśca mitrāṇi suhṛdaśca na: ।tvāmeva pratikāṁkṣante parjanyamiva karṣakā: ॥ 2.112.12॥

translations.english: All our relatives, warriors, friends and wellwishers long to see you like farmers yearn for the raincloud.
